halfLife.title: Radioactive decay clock
halfLife.hint: Each half-life, half of the remaining parent atoms turn into daughters. Counting the fraction left reads off the age.

isochron.title: Isochron plot
isochron.aria: Isochron plot at {t} half-lives elapsed, line slope {slope}

confidenceDial.title: Calibrated confidence dial
confidenceDial.hint: Drag the probability: each ordinary-sounding word carries an exact numeric range. "Virtually certain" means > 99%, not enthusiasm.

journeyTimeline.title: Twenty seconds
journeyTimeline.hint: Drag the timeline: oxygen in the blood stays full, but the oxygen cells can actually use collapses.

maskOff.title: Mask off
maskOff.body: The air has oxygen to spare — lungs fill, blood runs bright red. Nothing feels wrong yet.

h2sFloods.title: H₂S floods in
h2sFloods.body: Hydrogen sulfide diffuses into the blood and latches onto the respiratory enzyme in your mitochondria.

histotoxic.title: Histotoxic hypoxia
histotoxic.body: The blood is still full of oxygen, but the cells can no longer BURN it. This is the paradox: suffocating in a sea of oxygen.

collapse.title: Collapse
collapse.body: Starved of energy, the brain falters: vision narrows, legs give way, awareness slips.

unconscious.title: Unconscious
unconscious.body: About twenty seconds after the mask came off, you are down. Not from a lack of oxygen — from chemistry.
